subject.title: Feature request: cron job auto-retry on failure (--retry-count, --retry-delay)

question: Should OpenClaw add per-job cron retry controls on top of the shipped global `cron.retry` policy?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug fix: it defines public CLI flags, Gateway schema fields, persisted job semantics, and interaction with existing global retry/backoff behavior.

options.title: Approve narrow per-job controls
options.body: Add an additive job-level retry policy with explicit clear/zero semantics, protocol compatibility, docs, and tests while preserving global defaults.

options.title: Keep global retry only
options.body: Declare v2026.6.11's global recurring transient retry behavior sufficient and close or narrow this request to docs/status visibility only.

options.title: Fold into reason-aware guardrails
options.body: Move per-job retry policy into the broader reason-aware cron guardrail design tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/14376.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow per-job controls
recommendation.body: Add an additive job-level retry policy with explicit clear/zero semantics, protocol compatibility, docs, and tests while preserving global defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently authored and merged the global recurring retry behavior and is closest to the current scheduler tradeoff.
